name: Advance & Earn
org: NYC Department of Youth and Community Development (DYCD)
city: New York City (citywide, including Manhattan and the Bronx)
what_you_do: A program to get ready for the High School Equivalency (HSE) test. You earn job certificates and do a paid internship. After a short school test, you are placed in one of three tracks.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 16 to 24 who are not in school and not working. You need at least a 5th grade reading level. The Advanced Training track needs a high school diploma or HSE.
pay_detail: The page says participants are paid at each program level. It does not state the pay rate.
deadline_text: No dates are posted. Contact DYCD Community Connect (1-800-246-4646) to find a provider.
how_to_apply: The page has no application form. Call DYCD Community Connect at 1-800-246-4646 to find a provider near you.
notes: The page lists these training areas: Healthcare, Construction, Transportation and Culinary Arts. It also lists Digital Marketing. Direct Service Professionals is listed too. It does not say if you need a work permit.
